name: Malt-O-Meal Frosted Mini Spooners (WARNING / REMISSION HACK)
whyItWorks: 6g of dense, tightly bound insoluble whole wheat twigs. Acts like rough sandpaper in an active flare or stricture.
prepOrOrderInstructions: NEVER touch during a flare. Remission-Only Hack: Pour warm lactose-free milk over a half-serving (25g) and wait 3-4 full minutes until it collapses into a soft porridge, and chew to liquid.
flareEmergencySwap: Swap immediately to Malt-O-Meal Original Hot Farina (10/10) or Crispy Rice (9.5/10) at the first sign of cramping.
